about:
Aviva Wholesale Inc. was founded in 2000 in Metairie, Louisiana, as a family-run and operated business. The company began by distributing and manufacturing textile goods, leveraging a network of over ten production plants located both domestically and internationally.

Today, Aviva operates as both a manufacturer and wholesaler, supplying a broad range of blank apparel — including T-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts, and raglan shirts — alongside heat press machines, heat transfer vinyl (HTV), and vinyl cutting plotters. The company sources from overseas factories in countries such as Pakistan, China, India, Bangladesh, Turkey, and Egypt, maintaining direct relationships that allow for product development and control over manufacturing. Its product lineup features brands like Gildan, Bella+Canvas, Laviva Sports, LAT Apparel, Next Level, Silhouette, and Mimaki.

The primary customers are custom apparel businesses, screen printers, and heat-transfer decorators who purchase at wholesale or retail levels. Aviva serves the promotional products and apparel decoration markets, offering same-day shipping on orders placed by noon Monday through Friday and free shipping on orders over $99.

The company emphasizes its overseas factory connections as a key differentiator, enabling product development and manufacturing oversight to deliver competitive pricing and quality. Family ownership since inception remains central to its operational approach.
